cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/bigtest.py << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, ipaddress, random
def ip(x): return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(x))
rng = random.Random(1)
# 30000 routes -> far more than 64 runs, must be rejected as invalid
routes = []
for i in range(30000):
    st = rng.randrange(0, 1 << 128)
    ln = rng.choice([16, 32, 64, 128])
    sz = 1 << (128 - ln)
    routes.append([ip(st // sz * sz) + "/" + str(ln), rng.randrange(0, 100)])
req = {"cases": [{"initial": routes, "transactions": [], "bursts": [],
                  "cache_pages": 2, "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 8, "decode": [0, 1, 2]}}]}
data = json.dumps(req).encode()
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=data,
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('rc', p.returncode, '%.1fs' % (time.time()-t), p.stdout[:60])
EOF
timeout 175 python3 -B /tmp/bigtest.py
